Without A-Life: slow sniper cover over 4 hours, 20/40/60 zombies (+20 after the checkpoint). Once every 7 days.

Bites and zombie infection can never be treated. Once every 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec_Desc_dewey: Picks the nearest vehicle within 10 tiles when you ask and repairs that car 8-10 hours later (even if moved). 40: parts +30 (max 70) / 60: +50 (max 85) / 80: all 100 and a charged battery. The engine is hard to fix and gets half (+15/+25/+50). Missing parts are not replaced. Once every 7 days.
